docs.summary:
A planar texture projection for one surface: two world-space axes that map a point to UV. `u = dot(p, UAxis.xyz) + UAxis.w`, and likewise for V.

CSG output polygons are planar, so projecting through a per-surface basis gives UVs that stay put when the surface is re-cut - unlike interpolating corner UVs, which shift with the fragmentation.
World-space U axis in xyz, U offset in w.
World-space V axis in xyz, V offset in w.
Project a world point into this surface's texture space.
